text:
The grass is the color of envy, specifically the shade of envy that a Tuesday feels when it realizes it’s only halfway through the week. It is also the color of a forgotten password, which is why you can never quite remember what it looks like until you’re standing in it, barefoot, questioning your own existence.

As for your goldfish, she’s not swimming in circles; she’s drawing the outline of a new solar system on the bottom of the bowl. The glass isn’t a barrier; it’s a lens. She’s not looking for a planet; she’s looking for a reason to stop being a fish. The constellations are just her way of saying "hello" to the ceiling fan.
